Name: Crops Anytime Anywhere
Author: Pathoschild
Description:
Grow crops & fruit trees in any season and location, including on grass/dirt tiles you normally couldn't till. You can optionally configure the seasons, locations, and tillable tile types.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/develop/CropsAnytimeAnywhere/docs/screenshot.gif[/img]
Note: The mod doesn't change store inventories, so you can only buy seeds during their usual seasons.


[size=6][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
You can optionally [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/CropsAnytimeAnywhere#configure]customise the mod settings[/url] (including which seasons allow any crops).


[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer (must be installed by the main player).
[/list]
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1601]Winter Grass[/url] (grass grows in every season).
